key_insight: This study releases the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing thousands of compounds with tunable band gaps and magnetic character.
engineering_relevance: The dataset accelerates materials screening for perovskite photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition to electronic structure and bonding behavior.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT DOS calculated for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 compounds (X = I, Br, Cl, F)
Stability screening based on the τ tolerance factor of Bartel et al.
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 computed compounds, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metals, providing a broad evaluation of structure-property space.
watch_item: The results are computational predictions, so materials claims should still be validated experimentally before device integration.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
